LABUAN FOUNDATIONS ACT 2010

LABUAN FOUNDATIONS (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 80(1) of the Labuan Foundations Act
2010 [ Act 706], the Minister, on the recommendation of the Authority, makes the
following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1.         (1)  These regulations may be cited as the Labuan Foundations
(Amendment) Regulations 2013.

(2)    These Regulations come into operation on 1 April 2013.

Substitution of Third Schedule
2. The Labuan Foundations Regulations 2010 [ P.U. (A) 418/2010] are amended by
substituting for the Third Schedule the following Schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE
(Regulation 9)
PAYMENT OF FEES
No. Item Fee

(USD/RM)
1. Registration of  a Labuan foundation under subsection
14(1).
USD200/RM750
2. Annual fee under subsection 70(2). USD200/RM750
3. Approval for change of name under subsection 18(4). USD100/RM300
4. Restoration to the register under subsection 22(2). USD200/RM750
5. Redomicilation under subsection 23(2). USD200/RM750
6. Each search or an inspection of any document filed or
lodged with the Authority in respect of the Labuan

(b) by any other person approved by the council or

Authority of any document in its custody.
